blurb: A pseudonymous account on X with a focus on precious metals — primarily silver and gold — and associated macroeconomic and monetary themes. The account is associated with the broader silver-squeeze and hard-money community that gained prominence through Reddit's WallStreetSilver forum and proliferated across X through the 2021–2026 cycle of precious-metals speculation. No institutional affiliation is publicly disclosed.
credibility_note: The account's February 2026 post calling for a 'HUGE' silver and gold event on February 12, 2026 did not materialise: silver traded near $82.49 that day, unremarkably, well below its January 29 all-time high of roughly $121.78. The post is an example of the heads-I'm-prophetic / tails-quietly-deleted genre common to anonymous financial influencers — vague enough to claim credit if market conditions cooperate, specific enough to sound authoritative in advance. No verifiable track record of predictive accuracy is publicly available.
